title: Remove sqlx dependency from all three servers
description: The ultimate test of zero-SQL-in-servers: remove sqlx from Cargo.toml in broadside, smallhold, and gaja. If it compiles, all SQL is in fieldwork. Any compilation error reveals a leaked sqlx::query call. Servers should only depend on fieldwork (which owns sqlx internally). Servers never import sqlx directly.
close_reason: sqlx removed from all server Cargo.tomls. sqlite/postgres references removed from all business logic. Database backend is fully encapsulated behind fieldwork::db::Pool.
